svg.title: EP2 C5 AREA 28
svg.desc: Climb East Tower and descend West Tower. Stay grouped on dangerous floors and do not lose time on ordinary crates. Use the source-numbered rooms as the route order; colored symbols identify switches, barriers, warps and fixed pickups.
